scope: Historical photographic-plate transient candidate adjudication after physical-pair census
principles: Freeze the complete physical pair census before population-level candidate adjudication.
Use physical exposure start/end times and actual common-overlap interval as authoritative timing; retain legacy catalogue timing only as provenance.
A raw positional coincidence is a candidate-generation event, not evidence of transience.
Interpret raw coincidence counts against shifted/randomised background controls.
Catalogue association must be epoch-aware and proper-motion-aware; catalogue absence is never proof of transience.
Local astrometric registration must be independent of the science target and any identified target catalogue source.
Compact or stellar-looking morphology alone is not proof of a flash or transient.
Other-epoch non-detections are scientifically usable only when local sensitivity/recovery demonstrates that an equivalent source should have been detectable.
Copies, duplicate scans, or derivatives of the same physical plate are provenance/artifact controls, not independent astronomical observations.
API, transport, cache, or execution failures are operational states and must never be converted into scientific non-detections.
Measurements and interpretation labels must remain separable and auditable.
No thresholds may be relaxed or retuned in response to an individual candidate outcome.

primary.window_choice: smallest window meeting minimum reference count

sparse_field_fallback.trigger: primary common-reference solution has fewer than 5 references at 30 arcmin
sparse_field_fallback.interpretation: May support or weaken an ordinary-source/astrometric explanation but is not equivalent in confidence to the primary common-reference solution.

morphology.interpretation: Morphology is compared empirically with local controls and cannot independently establish transience.

recurrence_and_sensitivity.comparison_exposures: prefer nearest adequate preceding and subsequent same-field exposures from the same observing system; independent archives may add corroboration
required_measurements: local candidate-coordinate SNR or forced measurement
equivalent-source injection/recovery or an empirically equivalent completeness test
recurrence_and_sensitivity.negative_evidence_rule: A non-detection counts only if the comparison exposure demonstrably had adequate local sensitivity.

dashboard_contract.source_of_truth: immutable result artifacts plus automation registry/state
